description: Source code for the VideoRenderAlgorithm class, implementing video frame rendering, timing adjustments, and frame dropping logic for Android platform within the Cobalt project.

classes.name: VideoRenderAlgorithm
classes.description: Handles video frame rendering, timing, and frame dropping based on media time and system clock.

classes.name: VideoRenderAlgorithm::VideoFrameReleaseTimeHelper
classes.description: Helper class for adjusting frame release times using JNI calls to Java.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Main rendering loop that processes video frames, manages timing, and drops or displays frames accordingly.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified media time, informing the frame tracker if available.

methods.name: GetDroppedFrames
methods.description: Returns the number of frames dropped, updating via frame tracker if available.

methods.name: VideoFrameReleaseTimeHelper::AdjustReleaseTime
methods.description: Adjusts the frame release time based on presentation timestamp, system time, and playback rate via JNI.
